edition.cue: Serve the mains when the bus jumps the freeway gap.

s.note: Baked nachos with cheddar, jalapeños and black beans
s.how: Spread a 300g bag of corn chips on a tray. Scatter over a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until melted. Top with sour cream and a jar of salsa.

s.note: Smoky buttered pretzels and peanuts, baked and bagged for the ride
s.how: Toss 200g hard pretzels and 200g roasted peanuts with 50g melted butter and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Spread on a tray and bake at 160C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool and tip into paper bags.

m.note: Chargrilled citrus skirt steak in doubled corn tortillas
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes and 1 orange, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Grill very hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and chop. Serve in doubled corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.

w.note: Choc chip cookie ice cream sandwiches rolled in sprinkles
w.how: Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 5 minutes. Sandwich a thick scoop between two soft choc chip cookies, using 8 cookies for 4 sandwiches. Roll the edges in sprinkles, wrap in baking paper and freeze for an hour.

d.note: Cold brew over ice with milk and a scoop of ice cream
d.how: Steep 100g coarsely ground coffee in 1L cold water in the fridge overnight, then strain. Pour over ice in four tall glasses, about 200ml each, add a splash of milk and float a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.
